meta.title: AUD/JPY · CPES indicator on M3 · 1-minute binary expiry · historical backtest
meta.data_source: Yahoo Finance chart API, symbol AUDJPY=X, interval 1m
meta.indicator: Candle Pattern Entry Signals (38 Patterns), default inputs, unchanged
meta.method: M3 candles built from 1-minute candles (UTC-aligned). Entry = signal M3 candle close at its close time. Expiry price = close of the 1-minute candle that starts at entry (the last quoted price before entry + 60 s).
disclosures: Exact tick prices were not available (the tick-data provider refused downloads), so the expiry price is the 1-minute candle close: the last quote before the expiry second, not a tick at the exact second.
The price feed is Yahoo Finance AUDJPY=X. It may differ slightly from your Quotex or TradingView feed, so individual signals can differ.
Sunday 22:00–24:00 UTC is missing from this feed and the 23:59 minute is missing on most days. Trades that depend on a missing minute are marked VOID and not counted.
Forex is closed from Friday 22:00 to Sunday 22:00 UTC, so Saturday Nov 21 and Sunday Nov 22 have no trades.

info_all_signals.note: Information only — not money. What every priced signal would have scored if the balance had never run out.
